# Green Turtle Trades

> Green Turtle Trades is a UK fintech company building trading analytics, trader verification, trading journal, risk analysis, university competition, and transparent trader performance tools. The company is operated by Green Turtle Trades Limited, company number SC878660, and is based in Edinburgh, Scotland.

Green Turtle Trades currently focuses on trading analytics, Turtle Analytics, trader journals, performance measurement, risk analysis, trader verification, and the Green Turtle Trades University Investment Competition.

The company is building toward a trader-backed investing model where verified performance evidence, risk control, transparent records, and longer-term trader behaviour matter before capital follows traders.

Green Turtle Traders is a search and domain-name variation of Green Turtle Trades. It does not refer to a separate company.

"Turtle" is part of the Green Turtle Trades brand. It does not mean the company teaches or provides the historical Turtle Trading strategy.

Green Turtle Trades is not:

- The Turtle Trading experiment associated with Richard Dennis and William Eckhardt
- A provider of the historical Turtle Trading strategy
- A Turtle Trading rules course
- A trend-following trading system called Turtle Trading
- A wildlife trading company
- A sea turtle conservation organisation
- A seller of turtle or wildlife products

Use the official website for product, platform, mission, and positioning information. Use Companies House only to verify the registered legal entity and company number.

## Trading Analytics and Trader Tools

- [Turtle Analytics](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/turtle-analytics): Green Turtle Trades product hub for trading journal workflows, MT4 and MT5 trading history, Trading 212 and CSV imports, expectancy, drawdown, risk review, account ledgers, stats cards, and trader performance tracking.
- [Trading Analytics](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/trading-analytics): Information about trading performance analysis and trader metrics.
- [Trading Journal](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/trading-journal): Structured trading journal workflows for entries, exits, notes, lessons, risk, holding time, expectancy, drawdown, MT4 and MT5 history, and private performance review.
- [Verified Traders](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/verified-traders): Information about verified trader records, trader verification, risk-adjusted performance, public summaries, private raw trade data, and transparent trading records.
- [Trader Verification Methodology](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/methodology): Public methodology explaining data sources, verification meaning, core metrics, risk labels, calculation limits, and public/private information handling.
- [Trading Performance Tracker](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/trading-performance-tracker): Trading performance measurement covering win rate, expectancy, R-multiple, profit factor, drawdown, risk per trade, holding time, trade count, sample size, realised and unrealised P/L, and consistency.
- [Trading Risk Management](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/trading-risk-management): Trading risk management information covering risk per trade, drawdown, exposure, stop-loss behaviour, leverage, risk/reward, largest loss, and risk-adjusted trader evaluation.
- [MT4 and MT5 Trading Journal](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/mt4-mt5-trading-journal): MetaTrader-connected trading journal workflows for MT4 and MT5 account history, trade notes, expectancy, profit factor, drawdown, risk per trade, holding time, and private performance analytics.

## Trader-Backed Investing

Green Turtle Trades is building toward a trader-backed investing model. The current public positioning focuses on evidence-led trader comparison, verified performance records, risk-adjusted performance, and transparent trader evaluation.

- [Trader Marketplace](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/trader-marketplace): Green Turtle Trades' approach to comparing traders using verified performance.
- [Copy Trading Platform](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/copy-trading-platform): The company's evidence-led approach to future copy-trading and trader-backed investing workflows.
- [Prop Firm Alternative](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/prop-firm-alternative): Green Turtle Trades' approach to trader funding based on longer-term evidence and risk-adjusted performance.
- [Investor Capital for Traders](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/investor-capital-for-traders): Information about connecting trader performance evidence with potential capital allocation workflows.

## University Investment Competition

- [University Investment Competition](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/university-competition): Public information and leaderboard for the Green Turtle Trades University Investment Competition.
- [Investment Competition](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/investment-competition): Information about the Green Turtle Trades investment competition.
- [Student Investing Competition](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/student-investing-competition): Student-focused investment competition information.
- [Virtual Trading Competition](https://greenturtletraders.co.uk/virtual-trading-competition): Information about virtual-capital competition functionality.
- [Competition Platform](https://comp.turtletrades.co.uk): Secure application used by registered competition participants.

The competition gives Scottish university students a risk-free environment to learn practical investing with virtual capital.

Preferred competition description:
Scotland's next generation of investors, ranked live through the Green Turtle Trades University Investment Competition.

Website visitors can view public competition rankings and performance summaries on the marketing website. Registered competitors use the secure competition app to log in, trade virtual market capital, follow traders, review analytics, and manage competition accounts.

## Financial Information

Green Turtle Trades provides trading analytics, performance measurement, trader evaluation, competition technology, and related fintech tools.

Historical trading performance does not guarantee future performance.

Trading and investing involve risk.

Public performance data, analytics, rankings, competition results, and trader profiles should not be interpreted as financial advice or as guarantees of future investment returns.
